participants.channel_note: Interacts via the bank's wealth management portal (authenticated web/mobile). Receives pre-meeting review pack, accesses portfolio performance dashboard, completes online suitability questionnaire, reviews suitability report, and receives post-review confirmation and reports.

projections.projection_note: Client sees portfolio valuation summary and review schedule. Advisor notes and compliance flags are internal only.
Client sees their own questionnaire responses and updated risk score. Internal gap analysis flags are advisor-only.
Client sees proposed trades and consumer-facing rationale. Internal model weights and IC override flags are not disclosed.
Client receives the full MiFID II suitability report. Head of Suitability sign-off notes are internal compliance records.
Client receives post-trade confirmation and updated portfolio report. Internal fair value score is not disclosed.

entitlements: Complete suitability questionnaire (SuitabilityAssessment — own responses only)

notifications.content: Annual portfolio review confirmation with meeting date, pre-meeting questionnaire link, and review pack.
MiFID II suitability report available for review and acknowledgement.
Trade execution confirmation with trade summary and updated portfolio allocation.
Annual review complete: updated portfolio valuation, performance report, and next review date.

participants.channel_note: Interacts via the bank's internal wealth management platform (SVC-016 advisor interface — e.g. Wealth Dynamix CRM overlay on the Wealth Platform Service). Has full access to client suitability records, portfolio data, compliance flags, and trade execution workflows.

projections.projection_note: Advisor sees full prior suitability record and all system flags. No fields withheld.

data_exposed: SuitabilityAssessment (full live questionnaire, risk score, gap analysis, sustainability preferences)
projections.projection_note: Advisor has full view of the suitability assessment in progress.

data_exposed: RebalancingRecommendation (full including internal model weights and IC override flags)
ClientAccountSummary (cash balance data from CAP-001 — received via async event)
projections.projection_note: Advisor has full view including internal attribution and model recommendation detail.
Advisor can see and edit the draft suitability report before issuance.
Advisor validates and dispatches post-review reports.

entitlements: Read and write client suitability record (SuitabilityAssessment)
Request cash balance data from CAP-001 (via async event — ALT-002)

notifications.content: Client review due: review pack ready, pre-meeting questionnaire dispatched to client.
Client suitability questionnaire completed — updated risk profile available.
Client has acknowledged suitability report. Ready to submit trade instructions.

notifications.trigger: All rebalancing trades confirmed or any trade fails
notifications.content: Execution summary: [N] trades completed, [N] failed. Review and action required.
Annual review complete: validate post-review report before dispatching to client.
